unresolvedReferences.description: 孟磨愛呂, 磨柰蒙匡里荅八剌, 甫祿堡 and 木都彈禿 are listed with household counts; they may be settlements rather than chiefs, so no person rows were created. 磨欲 is likewise unclear.
三摻 is rendered 'three San officials'; it may instead be a personal name (Sancan). No person row was created.
阿散吉牙 (Asanjiya) is treated as Asange 阿散哥也 because he and his brothers confessed to killing their lord; the chapter does not state the identity outright.
The Zhiyuan 17 Champa king 保寶旦拏囉耶邛南詙占把地囉耶 and the Zhiyuan 19 king 孛由補剌者吾 are kept separate; the chapter does not say whether they are the same ruler.
一蠻人 (one barbarian) defying orders with Bude is an unnamed individual; the chapter gives nothing more, so no person row was created.
The crown prince 太子 is not identified; he may be Bude, but the unit does not say.
大拔撒機兒 may be a title (the great Basajier) rather than a personal name; kept as one person with uncertain naming.
撮及大師 may be a name plus the title Grand Master (大師), or two people; kept as one person.
Pacification Commissioner Chen 陳安撫 is probably Chen Zhongda of Qiongzhou from the previous chunk; this chunk names only the surname.
其謀臣 (his counselor) Xiningguan: the chapter does not make clear whose counselor he was.
The unnamed king of Java (爪哇主) is not identified with Hajigedang of Gelang; the chapter treats them separately.
The 'I' of the secret message is one of the two chancellors (Mayinde or Bulali); the chapter does not say which. The speaker's confiscated wife and children are therefore not linked to a person.
僧撮及班 is read as two monks, Suo and Ban, following the English; it could be one name.
阿不合大王城 names a city after a 'great king Abaha'; treated as a place, and no person row was created.
